Michi Lumin and friends sent a dogecoin (DOGE) transaction using HF/LoRaWAN (low-cost radio technology) and the Starlink satellite network.

(3/3)

Dogecoin isn't the first cryptocurrency to be transmitted over the airwaves. People have been able to push #BTC transactions without internet access thanks to concepts like mesh networking, amateur radio equipment, and portable antennas.

(2/3)

A DOGE transaction was sent via radio using a protocol called "Radio Doge," according to Dogecoin developer Michi Lumin. Radio Doge, according to proponents, will "enable access to dogecoin for people outside the internet's reach."
